heroSummary: PGCPS schedules Student Orientation Day on August 24 before all students begin August 25. The 180-student-day calendar includes half-day releases for grading and teacher professional work, plus three possible Inclement Weather Make-Up Days.
seoTitle: PGCPS Calendar 2026-2027: Prince George's Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: View the PGCPS 2026-2027 school calendar with first day, last day, holidays, early dismissal days, Winter Break, Spring Break, PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: Prince George's County Public Schools starts the 2026-2027 school year for all students on August 25, 2026 and ends on June 15, 2027 with an early dismissal day. Student Orientation Day is August 24, 2026. Winter Break runs from December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. Spring Break and spring closures run from March 26 through April 2, 2027. The updated calendar lists 180 student days, 192 teacher days, quarter end dates, early dismissal days, professional development days, parent-teacher conferences, religious observances, and three possible inclement weather make-up days.

calendarFaqs.q: When does PGCPS start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Prince George's County Public Schools starts the 2026-2027 school year for all students on Tuesday, August 25, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is PGCPS Winter Break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: PGCPS Winter Break runs from Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is PGCPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: PGCPS lists spring closures from Friday, March 26 through Friday, April 2, 2027, including Good Friday, the Monday after Easter, and Spring Break.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the PGCPS 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The updated PGCPS 2026-2027 calendar lists 180 student days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for PGCPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for students is Tuesday, June 15, 2027, and it is listed as an early dismissal day.

customSections.label: PGCPS Calendar Important Dates for Families
customSections.content: Families usually check the PGCPS calendar first for the first day of school, Student Orientation Day, early dismissal dates, professional development days, parent-teacher conferences, winter closures, spring closures, quarter endings, inclement weather make-up days, and the last day of school. These dates affect childcare, transportation, work schedules, after-school activities, and family travel in Prince George's County.

customSections.label: Planning Around the PGCPS 2026-2027 Calendar
customSections.content: Families often use the PGCPS school calendar to plan childcare, family travel, work schedules, transportation, and after-school activities. One of the longest scheduled student breaks is Winter Break from December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. Families should also watch early dismissal days, professional development days, parent-teacher conference days, and inclement weather make-up days because those dates can change pickup times or become instructional days.

customSections.label: Important Updates for the PGCPS 2026-2027 Calendar
customSections.content: The 2026-2027 PGCPS calendar source is marked as approved January 22, 2026 and updated July 16, 2026. This section highlights dates families should recheck each year rather than assuming they match a saved copy of a previous PGCPS calendar. Families comparing this year with an older calendar should review the start date, final student day, early dismissal schedule, parent-teacher conference date, religious observances, and the listed inclement weather make-up days.

customSections.label: PGCPS Calendar Download Options
customSections.content: Use the PGCPS calendar tools to view the official PDF, download a printable PDF, import the ICS calendar into Google Calendar or Apple Calendar, save early dismissal and closure dates, and share school-year dates with family members. Always verify final schedule changes with the official Prince George's County Public Schools calendar source before making critical plans.
